name: Cool Kaichou Rin no Iinari Isshuukan ~Harenchi Meirei de Koibito Kozukurizuki no Sukebe Shikyuu ni Natte Shimau!~
original_name: クール会長凛のいいなり一週間～破廉恥命令で恋人子作り好きのスケベ子宮になってしまう！～
source:
The main character, Harada Kyouichi is excellent at but not interested in fencing. His childhood friend Rin is angered by this and challenges him to a duel. He accepts on the condition that if she loses, she has to follow a weekly order from him.

He defeated Rin who surrendered. Unexpectedly she accepts the conditions and immediately recognizes she loves him. They become lovers and begin a romantic school life.
translation:
主角原田恭一擅长击剑，但对击剑不感兴趣。他儿时的朋友凛对此感到愤怒，并向他发起决斗挑战。他接受的条件是，如果她输了，她必须遵守他每周的命令。

他击败了投降的凛。没想到她接受了条件，并立即意识到自己爱他。他们成为恋人，开始浪漫的校园生活。
